coordinates.convention: X = master-map left/right, Z = height, Y = added depth. Negative Y is toward the viewer of the master map; positive Y is deeper into the scene.
coordinates.map_space: pixels of the 7600 px wide reading version of 00_Master/master_map.png.png (docs/reference_review/master_map_7600.jpg); x to the right, y downward
coordinates.origin_meaning: Fountain statue centre in X; rain-well ground and water datum of the central wells in Z. East-city ground is lower (about map y 3640).
coordinates.scale_note: 1 Blender unit = H = about one player-character height, an art yardstick only. Estimated from three same-image ratios (14-17 px per H); uncertainty about 10 percent. Not an official or real-world size.

depth_defaults.note: All Y values are level-C design choices; the master map gives no depth.

layers.FRONT: Front (viewer-side) walls of interiors. Hidden for elevation checks so rooms can be read like the master map; shown for top, oblique and back views.
layers.CEILING: Cave ceilings and overhangs that would hide the city in a top view.
layers.HOSTROCK: Level-C fill for black or unshown areas of the master map that need a supporting mass. Not observed structure.
layers.BACKDROP: Simplified distant shell towers and spires with real volume, placed deep in Y for parallax.
layers.CAVESHELL: Outer cavern boundary: base, back wall and end walls.
layers.REFERENCE: Region labels, connection lines and the scale figure. Never part of the city.
layers.FOREGROUND: Level-C tower row on the viewer side of the wells. Hidden for elevations and any view taken from far in front; shown for top, back and in-well views.
